payload.claim: The docstring says the returned namespace holds "the batch's own stop line (`None` if it never closed)", but the code at lines 6975-6995 returns two separate fields for this: `status` (the ledger row's status column, `None` when no row exists) and `stop_lines` (a list of matching console lines, default `[]`). The docstring never mentions `stop_lines` at all, even though every acceptance-criterion assertion in this file (e.g. `at_total.stop_lines == ["batch: DRAINED"]`, `with_corpse.stop_lines == []`) reads that field, and the "`None` if it never closed" clause only fits `status`, not the list-valued `stop_lines`.
